A comedy of terrors begins in The Fog. Dead by Daylight: Terrifier brings horror icons The Terrifier and Sienna Shaw into The Fog alongside a new original Map, Hartshorne Mall. Purchasing this add-on unlocks the Art Crispies Cereal charm and the Clown Cafe Banner.

Dead by Daylight: Terrifier is out on XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and XBOX One today.

Gothic 3 Classic is OUT NOW on XBOX Series X|S!

Choose your allies, earn powerful factions' trust, and shape the future of a kingdom torn apart by war in this legendary open-world RPG. The fate of Myrtana is in your hands!

Featuring improved controls, enhanced performance, and the acclaimed Community Patch 1.75, Gothic 3 Classic is the smoothest way to experience the legendary RPG adventure.
